clues: This town has more folk than any town in its land. It was built to be a new chief town, in place of an old packed port.
The dry time runs from December to April. Then a long wet time takes hold, with heavy rains from May to November.
This town was founded in 1939. It took its name from the second head of state of its land.
This town was built from bits of four old towns and eight vast farms. The state bought the farms up for its grand plan.
This town was the chief town of its land for near three decades. It lost that rank in 1976, when the old port took it back.
